summary: Sponsor-reported upper-limb benefit supports the amended application, but earlier FDA statistical objections remain unresolved in the packet. Added follow-up is open-label. The prior investigation reports excess hypersensitivity; manufacturing is unassessed.
pivotalQuestion: Do the amended analyses establish a clinically meaningful, statistically robust upper-limb benefit despite FDA’s earlier analysis-plan objections?

factors.rationale: Capricor reports HOPE-3 endpoint success; FDA previously found analysis-dependent significance and questioned post-completion, pre-unblinding revisions. The amendment adds robustness analyses, but 24-month open-label follow-up does not extend the randomized comparison.
The supplied prior investigation reports FDA-noted excess hypersensitivity versus placebo and possible functional unblinding. This is secondary reporting; no updated safety assessment is provided.
The packet does not establish manufacturing readiness or FDA manufacturing clearance. The reported BIMO observation concerns clinical research oversight, not CGMP compliance.

Capricor reports acceptance of the upper-limb amendment and extended review. July’s unfavorable cardiomyopathy assessment is not a decision on it; the prior investigation reports a BIMO observation with closure unestablished.
